description: Single source of truth for review-mode limits and feature-gating. Loaded at runtime by scripts/preprocess.py (maxEffectiveLoc/maxSourceFiles, allowSystemGraph), scripts/validate_report.py (allowPatch/allowGasSuggestions/allowExecutiveSummary/allowArchitectureChecks, rules R-06/R-09) and scripts/render_report.py (allowHtmlReport, rule R-06). Edit this file to change mode behavior; no script hardcodes a second copy of these values. A missing or malformed copy of this file makes every script that needs it fail explicitly - see scripts/preprocess.py's ModesConfigError.
